messages:
IncidentBot: Pager alert: high 5xx rate on inference-embeddings eu-west-1 — service degraded (alerts: embed-500-rate > 5% for 5m). Creating incident thread for mitigation and customer comms.

Alex Chen: I'm on it. spinning up investigation. tagging oncall Lia.

Lia Huang: oncall here. quick status: CPU on inference pool spiked, autoscaler not adding nodes due to quota error. seeing 503/504s on embedding routes.

SRE Bot: autoscaler events: 
```
Event: ScaleUpFailed - reason: QuotaExceeded
nodepool.gke: requested 4 -> available 0
```

Samir Patel: Got logs. looks like upstream model process OOMs after warmup under sustained burst. Retrying with smaller batch size should reduce P99.

Alex Chen: mitigation plan: 1) reduce batch size on embedders to 8, 2) enable fallback to quantized-model-v2 for non-critical requests, 3) open quota ticket with infra. Lia can you apply the config change?

Lia Huang: applying now. patch: 
```
PATCH /services/embeddings/config
- batch_size: 32
+ batch_size: 8
```
Deployed to canary. Monitoring.

SRE Bot: Canary metrics: error-rate -> 1.2% (from 8.9%), latency +80ms. Fallback routing active for 12% of traffic.

Alex Chen: good. keep monitoring. next: we need to prepare customer-facing status page and SLA/comp notes — Maria, can you draft the status page blurb and a customer email template? We'll need to assess SLA credit eligibility after we confirm total downtime and impacted windows.

Maria Gomez: working on it. draft status page blurb below — please review.
```
Status: Partial degradation in eu-west-1 affecting embedding generation. Impact: higher error rates and elevated latencies for embedding API calls. Mitigation: reduced batch sizes and temporary model fallback; traffic being shifted to healthy pools. ETA for full restoration: TBD. Next update in 30m.
```

Jen Park: For customer emails we should include: what happened, who was affected (scoped to eu-west-1 / embedding namespace), what we did, what we will do to prevent recurrence, and credit/compensation next steps. I can draft a template once Maria posts a short version.

Samir Patel: I'm pulling impacted request counts to estimate SLA windows. quick calc script: 
```
# rough eligibility check
impacted_minutes = 42
affected_rate = 0.12
eligible = impacted_minutes >= 30 and affected_rate >= 0.1
# rough credit bands: <1hr -> 10%, 1-4hr -> 25%, >4hr -> 50%
```
Prelim: outage window ~ 42m between 08:12 and 08:54 UTC, error spike concentrated on embedding route.

Billing Bot: Note: to issue credits we need: customer tenant IDs impacted (or global if public), invoice cycle, and playbook approval. I'll queue the billing ticket once we have impacted-customer list.

Alex Chen: Samir / Jen — can you produce an impacted-customer top-20 export? Use the request logs + routing metadata. Mark customers with >1% of their requests failed as 'impacted'.

Samir Patel: exporting now. snippet of query: 
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as total, sum(case when status >=500 then 1 else 0 end) as errors
FROM embed_logs
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2023-11-03T08:00:00Z' AND '2023-11-03T09:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Will post CSV shortly.

Maria Gomez: customer-facing email draft (short):
```
Hi <Customer>,
We experienced partial degradation of the embeddings API in eu-west-1 between 08:12 and 08:54 UTC on 2023-11-03. This caused increased errors and latency for some requests. We mitigated the issue by reducing batch sizes and routing affected traffic to a stable model variant.
We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a post-incident summary. If you experienced customer-impacting errors, you may be eligible for account credit; our billing team will reach out with details.
Thanks — Redwood Inference Support
```

Jen Park: looks good. add a line about how credits are applied: "Credits will be issued as account credits applied to your next invoice after eligibility review."

Maria Gomez: added.

Lia Huang: can we get sign-off to post the status page message? Alex?

Alex Chen: yes go ahead. Post and set statuspage priority: partial_degradation. Add note we'll update in 30m.

Maria Gomez: posted to status page. link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/ei-20231103-embed-deg (placeholder)

Jen Park: internal comms note for CS reps: 
"If customers ask: apologize, reference status page and say: 'We are assessing eligibility for account credit and will contact impacted customers directly by EOD tomorrow.'"

Alex Chen: Samir, once you have full list, include rough credit band recommendation and send to Billing Bot for action. Also tag Priya (SRE Lead) for RCA follow-up.

Samir Patel: uploaded CSV to /shared/incidents/1699001123/impacted_top20.csv. Preliminary credit recommendation: 10% credit for accounts with >1% error and >1000 calls in window.

Billing Bot: Created billing task: TICKET-8842 — awaiting credit approval and ledger IDs. Assign to Jen for approval.

Jen Park: I approve the recommended list for issuance under standard SLA policy. Billing Bot, please apply account credits in next billing cycle and send customer notifications per template.

Billing Bot: Applying credits: will batch update and include note 'SLA credit for service degradation eu-west-1 on 2023-11-03'. Expected completion: 2023-11-10.

Priya Rao (SRE Lead): quick note — please capture the autoscaler quota failure in the RCA. Also schedule a follow-up to evaluate batching defaults + OOM mitigation for model process.

Alex Chen: thanks all. Lia, will hand off monitoring to next oncall in 20m. any remaining actions?

Lia Huang: handoff checklist: monitors pinned, statuspage pinned, impacted list in drive, billing ticket created, post-incident retrospective scheduled. Passing oncall to Priya at 09:00 UTC.

SRE Bot: Handoff: oncall changed from Lia Huang -> Priya Rao at 1699005600 (09:00 UTC).

Alex Chen: closing thread for active mitigation. Keep the postmortem thread separate for RCA details.
